description: Sim 88 — RIFT CMB full CLASS external_Pk injection (Phase 5). Fixes referee vulnerability 3: prior result used a first-order modulation approximation to P(k). This simulation derives P(k) from the RIFT growth factor (D_RIFT vs D_LCDM via G_eff and modified H(z)), writes it as a CLASS-compatible external_Pk table, runs full CLASS perturbation theory, and compares C_ell^RIFT vs C_ell^LCDM.

rift_background.note: Best-fit from SIM87 full-cov BAO refit (2026-04-07)

external_pk.note: Δ²_R(k) = A_s * (k/k_pivot)^(n_s-1) * R_growth^2 where R_growth = D_RIFT(z=0)/D_LCDM(z=0)
